faqs: Can we customize the samurai artwork and sleeve graphics?

Yes. Send your own artwork, logo placements and color references. TONTON reviews panel layout, print alignment and branding before sample approval. Artwork permissions and final files must be confirmed.

The supplied brief specifies a polyester/spandex compression blend, but does not confirm an exact percentage or fabric weight. Composition, GSM and tolerances are agreed for the selected material during sampling.
Is a silicone anti-slip hem included?

What should we check on the sample?
Review shoulder movement, torso length, seam feel, stretch recovery, print alignment and appearance under stretch. Agree wash-test requirements and retain the approved sample for repeat orders.
What information is needed for a quote?

Send estimated quantity, size allocation, delivery country, target date, artwork and desired branding. Selected custom projects start from 10 pieces; minimums, sampling costs and timing are confirmed for your specification.
